lines.text: E-Rate FY 2026-27
CATEGORY 2 LITHIUM-ION UNINTERRUPTABLE BATTERY BACKUPS
Deadline for Submittal of Proposals
November 19th, 2026
Proposals to be opened
November 19th, 2026
Idaho Falls School District #91 690 John Adams Pkwy Idaho Falls, ID 83401

Idaho Falls School District 91 is requesting proposals update its existing Uninterruptable Battery Backup infrastructure. The completion of the purchase from this RFP will be entirely contingent upon full funding from the Universal Service Program for Schools and Libraries (E-Rate) and the District 91’s Board of Trustees approval of the project and budget for it’s portion. The awarded vendor must be a participating E- Rate service provider and maintain a valid SPIN. The requested equipment must be eligible under the E-Rate Category Two Internal Connections guidelines.
Description

The Idaho Falls School District 91 plans to take advantage of E-Rate funding discounts. Idaho Falls School District 91 expects providers to make themselves thoroughly familiar with any rules and regulations regarding the E-Rate program.
The awarded vendor will be responsible for procuring the SLD payment portion from the SLD via FCC Form 474.

Idaho Falls School District 91 reserves the right to deny any or all proposals associated with this RFP. The district reserves the right to have the contract award dependent upon SLD funding approval.
Bidders must clearly identify specifications for all products in their proposal.
All costs related to the project must be included in the bid price. Proposals must clearly identify costs associated with each item and/or service.
Proposals will be required to comply with all applicable local, state, and federal requirements and laws.
Bidders who attempt to influence staff or board members of the Idaho Falls School District 91 outside of official meetings and forums may have their proposals disqualified.

Sealed bids must be received by the Idaho Falls School District 91 by the bid due date (see page 1) at the Idaho Falls School District 91 Administration Office, 690 John Adams Parkway, Idaho 83401. The bid must include all descriptions and costs as well as the warranty and product availability sheet. Any bids received after this time and date will not be accepted. No bid may be withdrawn after the time of opening. Any bid may be withdrawn, either personally or by written request, at any time prior to the time set for bid opening.

The awarded proposal will be the one most cost effective and in the overall best interest of the Idaho Falls School District 91. Responsive proposals will be evaluated according to the following criteria: (1) cost of products and services, including non-eligible and indirect costs, (2) equipment specifications and performance, (3) provides for the continuation of the district’s network project roadmap (4) compatibility with district support tools and knowledgebase, and (5) prior experience with vendor and vendor track record.

It is the intent of the Idaho Falls School District 91 to award this project in a timely manner after the submission deadline, however, the actual purchase order will not be issued until after funding approval by the Board of Trustees and E-Rate program.
Authorization and Warranty
The vendor must be authorized to provide the specified products.
All physical components must be new and free from defect on arrival or must be replaced at no expense to Idaho Falls School District 91.
Components must be covered by the full manufacturer’s warranty.
Bid and Submitting
Prices quoted should not include excise or other exempt taxes.
The person signing the bid must make initial corrections or erasures in the bid. Bid must be signed in longhand in ink by a duly authorized person for the firm submitting the bid.
Questions should be directed to Pat Morgan at person1@sd91.org and Sam Rivera at person2@sd91.org with subject line: E-Rate RFP # 91-2026-3 UPS Questions
By submitting a bid on the items listed, the vendor agrees to comply with all descriptions, specifications, and conditions unless stated on the bid proposal itself.
Submit sealed proposals to Idaho Falls School District 91
Attention: E-Rate RFP # 91-2026-3 UPS
690 John Adams Parkway Idaho Falls, Idaho 83401
No faxed, telephoned, or emailed bids will be accepted.
Bids must be typed.
Bids and the Warranty and Product Availability Sheet are to be returned in a sealed envelope(s) with return address information.
Proper postage is required.
Opening of Bids

Bids will be opened at the time indicated on the cover page by the appointed district representative and in the presence of members of the I.T. department responsible for the maintenance of the proposed equipment or services.

Members of the public are invited to submit written objections to the specifications or bidding procedures but must be submitted no later than three (3) days prior to the date and time the bids are scheduled to be opened. Pursuant to Idaho Code Section 67-2806.
This sheet must accompany the bid proposal.
Company Name:
Erate SPIN #:
Vendor will invoice directly using FCC Form 474 (SPI Form) Yes No
The bid must include the following:
70 – Uninterruptable Battery Backup units
The district requires UPS systems to provide temporary battery backup and power conditioning for network infrastructure equipment, including but not limited to:
Core and distribution switches
Network routers
Wireless controllers
Firewall appliances
Network monitoring systems
The UPS systems will be deployed in designated hub rooms across district facilities to ensure network continuity during short-term power outages and power fluctuations.
